scientific_integrity: The formula is supported by a characteristic-independent alternating Fourier rank calculation and direct finite checks. Priority comparisons cannot rule out an older equivalent coadjoint-orbit formulation.
scientific_limitations: Counts associative-algebra additive commutators of all 3 by 3 upper triangular matrices over finite fields; not group commutators, higher triangular dimensions, or an independent priority determination. Exact proof and exhaustive small-field checks included.
title: Four-level commutator fibers in the three-by-three upper triangular algebra
